query: SELECT i.id,i.run_id,i.thread_id,i.agent_id,p.id AS participant_id,r.objective FROM chat_invocations i JOIN agents a ON a.id=i.agent_id JOIN chat_runs r ON r.id=i.run_id JOIN chat_participants p ON p.thread_id=i.thread_id AND p.agent_id=i.agent_id JOIN sidecar_conversations sc ON sc.thread_id=i.thread_id AND sc.agent_id=i.agent_id WHERE sc.storage='postgres' AND a.deployment_mode='sidecar' AND NOT a.paused AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status='pending' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sidecar_commands c WHERE c.invocation_id=i.id AND c.kind='invoke') ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 50;
